posts.name: Mezike
posts.cooked:
I'm soooo on the edge of pledging for this. But it just seems so damn expensive for what you get, at least with international postage anyway. I caved in and pledged on Up Front so a third $130+ pledge in the space of two months is a bit raw, even with selling off a lot of my old games to raise funds for the new ones. It just wouldn't be worth going for Devastation alone, $80 is way too much no matter how rave the reviews may be.

I'm not terribly keen on the graphic design or paucity of artwork either, but that's probably just >G spoiling us. I mean 578 cards, each with individual art, compared to roughly two dozen pieces of art over half as many cards? Unless I'm missing something here. I'm not looking for FFG overkill, and granted not everyone keeps a Rebottaro in the cupboard, but just a little bit of variation on the cards would add more life to the design.

Some parts of the design on Indines just look a little lazy too, like where the "N/A" overhangs the flash (why not leave it blank, or use a single dash?), or the special move card just being a greyscale of the character art. Yeah, it doesn't affect gameplay but I do like games to look nice as part of the whole experience

posts.name: Mezike
posts.cooked: yeah, I eventually did the same. There is an upgrade kit going out with this kickstarter that fixes the errata, but not the art. It's a bit annoying that things aren't really made clear but if you dig around various forum posts the designer is blowing on about clearing out the old stock before starting the reprint. Fair enough but it felt a bit off that they haven't been up front about the situation to potential backers. There really ought to be a discount on these if they are clearance as it's a bit nonsensical to pay full retail for an obsolete product. Especially when the value of second hand copies will plummet after the new edition comes out. Cancelled my backing as I know I will eventually get Devastation and all the bits much more cheaply from a retailer than from the kickstarter.
